name: Space Travel:Chronicles
detailed_description:
《Space Travel:Chronicles》

  • Genre: Pixel Narrative · Choice-Driven · Single-Player Story

  • Features: Suspenseful Time Paradox · 200+ Dialogue Choices · Zero-Combat Immersive Experience

  • Current Version: Complete Chapters 1-2 (Chapters 3-4 in Development, Free Update)

 

◆ Game Introduction

  • "When unfamiliar objects suddenly appear in your room, and your mother insists you have a 'sister you met last year'—your memories are betraying you."

  • Play as Rot, a high school student, navigating a town where reality is unraveling. Through 200+ dialogue choices, uncover the truth behind temporal anomalies. Every decision leads to one shocking conclusion.

 

◆ Core Gameplay

  • 🔍 Suspenseful Pixel Narrative

Temporal Anomalies: Mysterious guitars, packages from the nonexistent "Xinghai City," and legends of immortality from the year 2995.

Identity Crisis: A girl named Jiliya claims to be your sister, yet you have no memory of her.

  • 💬 Retro RPG Dialogue System

Choice-Driven Story: Shape Rot’s personality (cold/cooperative/aggressive) through responses (e.g., confronting "Jiliya" or stealing money from your closet).

NPC Reactions: Choices alter how characters treat you, though the main story remains linear.

  • 🎮 Classic Pixel Exploration

Interactive Objects: Investigate bizarre items (plastic seaweed, a spray-painted golden toilet, giant figurines).

Everyday Tasks: Mundane chores like "Breakfast Dilemma" reveal surreal truths.

 

◆ Story Highlights

  • ✓ The Guardians' Legend

"Ninety million years ago, the guardians (Rainbow) and (Shadow) clashed over the fate of broken timelines..."

  • ✓ Dark Humor & Oddities

A golden toilet you can flush repeatedly ("Wasted my excitement").

Relentless hatred for toast ("Goddammit! I’m sick of eating this!").

Hidden 10-yuan bills scattered everywhere.

  • ✓ Unsettling Daily Life

Your mother’s insistence about a sister you never had.

School rumors: "The Vanished Five", "The 500-Year-Old Student", and a serial killer on the loose.

A shadowy figure lurking near the abandoned power plant.

 

◆ Content & Roadmap

  • Feature Details

  • Current Length 3-5 hours (Chapters 1-2)

  • Dialogue Choices 200+ (30+ pivotal decisions)

  • Exploration Areas 6 zones (home, school, etc.)

  • Secrets 30+ investigatable objects

  • Future Updates Chapter 3: "Laws of Time" (free)

 

◆ FAQ

Q: Multiple endings?

  • → No. A single, crafted narrative, but choices unlock hidden lore and NPC interactions.

Q: Why no combat?

  • → Focused on psychological suspense.

  • (Note: QTE combat may be added later!~)

Q: Controller support?

  • → Keyboard-only for now (but possibly added in updates!).

 

◆ Final Notes

Enjoy your journey through time—and thank you for playing!

short_description: This is an RPG-style role-playing story game. The protagonist moves to a new town and starts high school, but during their time there, they encounter their sister from a parallel world. The protagonist then begins to investigate this mysterious situation.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Ukrainian, Russian, Hungarian, Indonesian, Turkish, Japanese, Polish, Thai, Swedish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Arabic, Korean, Serbian, Persian, Filipino
